node.title: A pencil core union forces off-pencil pairs into a Johnson complement
node.statement: For degree-<K polynomial pairs and a primitive pencil row of height h compatible with the receiver on U, every off-pencil pair with m-T joint agreements has at least A=m-T-K-h+1 agreements on the e-point complement. If A>e there are none; if 1<=A<=e and A^2>e(K-1), their number is at most floor(e(A-K+1)/(A^2-e(K-1))). Complete-core compatibility retains gcd roots. Row height is essential. Any proved shared-carrier joint-LIST cap on the complement may replace direct Johnson, with auxiliary degree/domain/agreement relaxations checked. This is a joint-pair count, not an MCA projection or Prize closure.
